name: reveal-card
title: Reveal Card
author: HoverUI (https://hoverui.com)
description: The media recedes and desaturates while the caption rises into the space it vacated. The exchange itself runs on inherited custom properties with no pointer handlers; a ResizeObserver measures the caption so the recession matches it, up to a ceiling of 28% of the media height — past that the caption overlaps media that never moved, so keep the caption under about a quarter of the media (a dev-only console warning names the overlap in px if you cross it). Keyboard support requires a focusable element inside your caption — a link or button — because the keyboard path is driven by :has(:focus-visible); a caption of plain text has no keyboard affordance. On touch and any device without hover it rests in the arrived state; under reduced motion it also rests arrived and receded, with no transform exchange to run — but hover and :focus-visible still desaturate the media over 220ms, and that colour shift is the whole of the reduced-motion response. Note: the component pins position, isolation and overflow on its own root, so content that must escape the card's bounds will be clipped.
